symbols.name: saved exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent saved below one in the time bound, 2^{-182}.
symbols.quote: Cost accounting totals the running time of every step of [The multiplication algorithm](multiplication-algorithm.md) and shows that it is $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$, where $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is the saved exponent.

relations.quote: Cost accounting totals the running time of every step of [The multiplication algorithm](multiplication-algorithm.md) and shows that it is $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$, where $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is the saved exponent.

The layout needs $O(p/K)$ chunk exchanges, since $d\ell=O(p)$, each cost bounded by $O(VK^\tau)$ in [Fast address-chunk interchange](address-interchange.md), so the normalized total is $O(p/K)K^\tau=O(pK^{\tau-1})$.
Each of at most $\ell$ rounds is bounded by $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$ in [Simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-layer.md).

derivations.quote: Dividing by $V$ and substituting these sizes makes each normalized cost a power $p^{1-g_i}$ with margin $g_i$ below one. Seven dominate.

The layout needs $O(p/K)$ chunk exchanges, since $d\ell=O(p)$, each cost bounded by $O(VK^\tau)$ in [Fast address-chunk interchange](address-interchange.md), so the normalized total is $O(p/K)K^\tau=O(pK^{\tau-1})$.
Repairing the fraction $O(d2^{-K})$ of exceptional addresses costs $o(V)$ since $K=\Theta(p^{\epsilon c})$, as do global setup and prime search.
Each of the seven powers is at most $1-2\kappa$, and any fixed power of $\log p$ is at most $p^\kappa$ eventually, so the total is $O(Tp\,p^{1-\kappa})=O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa})$
